name: Vegetable Lasagna
ingredients: 2 garlic cloves and ½ onion, minced
1 tbsp lemon juice and 1 tbsp nutritional yeast
steps: Mix the tofu with the lemon juice, nutritional yeast, half the herbs, spinach, salt and pepper to make a ricotta-style filling.
Heat the oil and cook the onion and garlic for 4 minutes. Add the zucchini, carrot, passata and remaining herbs and simmer for 10 minutes.
Spread a little sauce in a small baking dish. Layer a lasagna sheet, sauce and tofu filling; repeat to make 4 layers, ending with sauce.
Cover with foil and bake at 190°C for 25 minutes.
Uncover and bake for 10 minutes more. Rest for 10 minutes before cutting.
note: A vegan lasagna with a tofu ricotta; whole-wheat sheets add fibre.
